page.layout: Top: page number "76" at left and running head "EMBLEMA" above the title "MODERATA DVRANT." at full width. Middle: one engraving (emblem plate) with labelled captions on the cloak and figures, full width. Below the engraving: a four-line verse in italic, centred. Lower right: a catchword-like word "Quinq;" set right, below the verse.

main_text.head: MODERATA DVRANT.
main_text.p: [Engraving: a king seated on a throne under a canopy, with a counsellor, a scribe and a figure of an angel in a framed picture; a cloak-shaped sheet on the floor is inscribed with the words Philosophia, Philargyria, Vis, Ius civile, Pietas and Ius aequum, with a globe, a set square, a sceptre and sheaves of grain.]

p.i: Prima ministrorum in nostro sit Principe cura, vt
Cum timet ipse Deum gaudeat & simili:
Vt paribus studiis omnes tueantur egenos,
Atq; iniustorum sub pede colla premant.

page.notes: The engraving has inscriptions on the cloak that are partly unreadable at this scan resolution; they are described rather than transcribed. The word "Quinq;" at lower right is printed as a marginal signature-like mark and is given as a paragraph. The line "Cum timet ipse Deum gaudeat & simili:" ends with a colon-like mark that may be a printing error for a similar stop.
